part of 'int64_consumer_test.dart';

void verifyJSONKinds() {
  test('generated DateTime responses enforce precision and UTC bounds', () async {
    final transport = _ResponseTransport();
    final client = LuxoClient(transport);
    for (final text in [
      '2000-01-01T00:00:00.1234567890Z', '2001-02-29T00:00:00Z',
      '0000-01-01T00:00:00+00:01', '9999-12-31T23:59:59-00:01',
      '2000-01-01T00:00:00',
    ]) {
      transport.response = text;
      await expectLater(client.scalarDateTime(), throwsFormatException);
      transport.response = [text];
      await expectLater(client.arrayDateTime(), throwsFormatException);
      expect(() => ScalarArrays.fromJson({'dates': [text]}), throwsFormatException);
      expect(
        () => ScalarArraysInput.fromJson(_scalarArrayJSON()..['dates'] = [text]),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    }
  });
  test('generated scalar and model strings reject incomplete Unicode', () async {
    final transport = _ResponseTransport();
    final client = LuxoClient(transport);
    for (final text in ['\ud800', '\udfff', '\ud800x', '\udc00\ud800']) {
      transport.response = text;
      await expectLater(client.scalarString(), throwsFormatException);
      transport.response = ['valid', text];
      await expectLater(client.arrayString(), throwsFormatException);
      expect(() => ScalarArrays.fromJson({'strings': [text]}), throwsFormatException);
      expect(() => OptionalArrays.fromJson({'texts': [text]}), throwsFormatException);
      expect(() => Child.fromJson({'name': text}), throwsFormatException);
      expect(() => ChildInput.fromJson({'name': text}), throwsFormatException);
      expect(() => Payload.fromJson({'child': {'name': text}}), throwsFormatException);
    }
  });
  test(
    'JSON scalar lists reject wrong kinds before return or callback',
    _verifyScalarLists,
  );
  test(
    'JSON model and input arrays validate nested selected fields',
    _verifyModelLists,
  );
  test(
    'nullable JSON arrays preserve selection and validate elements',
    _verifyNullableLists,
  );
  test(
    'validated JSON lists stay growable and independent of source lists',
    _verifyMaterializedLists,
  );
}

void _verifyMaterializedLists() {
  final texts = <Object?>['发布', 'false', '9007199254740993'];
  final flags = <Object?>[false, true];
  final value = OptionalArrays.fromJson({'texts': texts, 'flags': flags});
  texts[0] = null;
  flags[0] = 'false';
  value.texts.value!.add('new');
  value.flags.value!.add(false);
  expect(value.texts.value, ['发布', 'false', '9007199254740993', 'new']);
  expect(value.flags.value, [false, true, false]);
  final empty = OptionalArrays.fromJson({'texts': [], 'flags': []});
  empty.texts.value!.add('first');
  empty.flags.value!.add(true);
  expect(empty.texts.value, ['first']);
  expect(empty.flags.value, [true]);
}

Future<void> _verifyScalarLists() async {
  final transport = _ResponseTransport();
  final client = LuxoClient(transport);
  final calls = [
    client.arrayString,
    client.arrayBoolean,
    client.arrayDateTime,
    client.arrayUUID,
    client.arrayDecimal,
    client.arrayEnum,
    client.namedEnums,
  ];
  final subscribers = _streamSubscribers(client, array: true);
  final indexes = [3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11];
  for (var kind = 0; kind < calls.length; kind++) {
    var delivered = 0;
    final cancel = await subscribers[indexes[kind]]((_) {
      delivered++;
    });
    for (final invalid in _wrongJSONKinds(boolean: kind == 1)) {
      // Do not read the result: a lazy cast must not defer failure to the caller.
      transport.response = [invalid];
      await _expectEagerFailure(calls[kind]);
      expect(() => transport.emit([invalid]), throwsA(isA<TypeError>()));
      expect(delivered, 0);
    }
    cancel();
  }
}

void _verifyModelLists() {
  final fields = ['strings', 'booleans', 'dates', 'uuids', 'decimals', 'enums'];
  for (final field in fields) {
    for (final invalid in _wrongJSONKinds(boolean: field == 'booleans')) {
      final partial = <String, dynamic>{
        field: [invalid],
      };
      expect(() => ScalarArrays.fromJson(partial), throwsA(isA<TypeError>()));
      expect(
        () => ScalarArraysInput.fromJson(_scalarArrayJSON()..addAll(partial)),
        throwsA(isA<TypeError>()),
      );
      expect(
        () => OptionalArrays.fromJson({'child': partial}),
        throwsA(isA<TypeError>()),
      );
    }
  }
}

void _verifyNullableLists() {
  final nullable = OptionalArrays.fromJson({
    'texts': null,
    'flags': null,
    'child': null,
  });
  expect(nullable.texts.value, isNull);
  expect(nullable.flags.value, isNull);
  expect(nullable.child.value, isNull);
  expect(nullable.nullableIntegers.isSelected, isFalse);
  for (final field in ['texts', 'flags']) {
    for (final invalid in _wrongJSONKinds(boolean: field == 'flags')) {
      expect(
        () => OptionalArrays.fromJson({
          field: [invalid],
        }),
        throwsA(isA<TypeError>()),
      );
    }
  }
}

List<Object?> _wrongJSONKinds({required bool boolean}) => [
  0,
  1,
  BigInt.parse('9007199254740993'),
  sdk.LuxoJSONNumber.parse('1.0'),
  null,
  [],
  {},
  if (boolean) ...['true', 'false', ''] else ...[true, false],
];

Future<void> _expectEagerFailure(Future<Object> Function() call) async {
  var rejected = false;
  try {
    await call();
  } on TypeError {
    rejected = true;
  }
  expect(
    rejected,
    isTrue,
    reason: 'The decoder must reject before the caller reads any element',
  );
}
